findings.body:
**Reject dependency metadata that is not a JSON object.**

In `apps/crq-python/ops/package-runner.py:169`, a dependency `package.json` containing `[]` or `null` causes `document.get` to raise `AttributeError`. `main` does not catch that exception. With `--json`, the command emits a traceback to stderr and no JSON error artifact.

Check `isinstance(document, dict)` before reading its fields. Raise `ArtifactError` when the check fails. As per coding guidelines, “In machine mode (`--json`) stderr stays empty” and an error without a result must emit one JSON error object.
findings.title: Reject dependency metadata that is not a JSON object.

findings.body:
**Verify the same archive bytes that were hashed.**

In `apps/crq-python/ops/package-runner.py:688`, hashing and extraction use separate opens of the archive pathname. If another process replaces that path after hashing, `_safe_extract` can accept the replacement's consistent manifest and inventory. The report still returns the original digest. Default smoke checks then execute code from the replacement.

Copy the archive into private temporary storage first. Check the digest and perform all extraction reads against that private copy.
findings.title: Verify the same archive bytes that were hashed.

findings.body:
**Restore the deployment if a post-checkout write fails.**

In `apps/crq-python/ops/prepare-host.py:774`, `record()` runs after checkout but outside the recovery block. If the audit filesystem fills after `switch-before`, this call fails with HEAD already changed and the target's committed config installed without host overrides. A retry then fails `drift_check()`.

Extend recovery across the post-checkout audit and config writes. Restore both `previous` and `current` on failure, or provide a durable recovery transaction before changing HEAD.
findings.title: Restore the deployment if a post-checkout write fails.

findings.body:
**Reject inherited drop-ins that override the verified unit.**

At `apps/crq-python/ops/unit-live-binding.py:713`, discovery checks only exact unit-name drop-in directories. A `service.d/override.conf` inside the scanned unit directory is not rejected. Its `ExecStart=` override also passes dependency scanning because that scanner checks dependency directives only.

Systemd applies type-wide drop-ins to the selected service. The main unit's `FragmentPath`, bytes and runtime pointer can therefore pass validation while release executes the override instead of the verified command. Reject applicable inherited drop-ins, or validate the effective drop-in set before mutation. Include dash-prefix drop-ins in that check. ([freedesktop.org](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/255/systemd.unit.html))
findings.title: Reject inherited drop-ins that override the verified unit.

findings.body:
**Include socket `Service=` targets in activation discovery.**

At `apps/crq-python/ops/unit-live-binding.py:92`, `DEPENDENCY_RE` omits `Service=`. A co-installed `ingress.socket` with `[Socket] Service=crq-tick.service` therefore passes the dependency scan. The prefix-filtered manager listings also omit `ingress.socket`.

Systemd uses this directive to select the service activated by incoming traffic. Discovery can report `supported=True` while this foreign activator remains outside the adapter's fence and restoration operations. Include `Service=` in activation-target validation and reject this topology before mutation. ([freedesktop.org](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/255/systemd.socket.html))
findings.title: Include socket `Service=` targets in activation discovery.

findings.body:
**Add the I1 machine-mode contract to `prepare-host.py`.**

`apps/crq-python/ops/prepare-host.py` defines no `--json` option. Machine-mode callers cannot use it: any invocation with `--json` fails argument parsing and writes usage to stderr. Operation failures after parsing also need the I1 JSON error object on stdout, with stderr empty in machine mode.

The sibling host scripts `deploy-controller.py`, `deploy-runbook.py`, `build-runner.py`, and `package-runner.py` implement `--json` and cite I1 for it. Add the same mode to `prepare-host.py`, covering parser errors and operation failures. Keep human narration on stderr outside machine mode.

No repository caller passes `--json` to this script today, so the gap affects machine consumers rather than current workflows.
findings.title: Add the I1 machine-mode contract to `prepare-host.py`.
